recipes.promptAddendum: The hood and the robe are a clear bright indigo, a violet-leaning blue: colour #4a43b5 on the lit left side and #372f8f in the folds, clearly blue cloth and much lighter than the black outline, never dark grey, charcoal, navy or black. The long pointed tip of the hood flops over to one side like a nightcap. The figure is drawn large: about 44 pixels wide and 72 pixels tall.
recipes.negativeAddendum: staff, wand, dagger, knife, beard, skull face, skeleton, grey robe, charcoal robe, black robe, navy robe, wizard hat brim, cape, wings
recipes.notes: initiate-a and initiate-b drew a slate-grey robe (57% and 63% dark): the cloth colours are given as hex values, as the Goblin batch found, and the size in pixels.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colour of the cloth: recolour the dark grey-blue hood and robe to a clear bright indigo, a violet-leaning blue, colour #4a43b5 on the lit left side and #372f8f in the folds and on the shaded right side. Keep the two big round cream eyes, the candle with its small green flame, the cream paper scroll, the brass badge, the cream slippers, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: initiate-a has the right shape (two cream eyes, candle, papers, slippers) in a slate-grey robe: a recolour edit with hex values.

recipes.promptAddendum: The top of its smooth round body has nothing on it: no horns, no flames, no candle and no lamp. Both eyes are pale yellow, colour #ffe27a, with black pupils. It stands on four fat curling tentacles like an octopus, never on legs with toes. Nothing on it glows green. The monster is drawn large: about 62 pixels wide and 66 pixels tall.

recipes.notes: horror-a is the best ball: an edit that names one part, the horns and the lamp.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the four feet: replace each leg and its toes with one short fat teal tentacle that curls outward on the ground, with small pale cream suckers on its underside, like the arms of an octopus. recipes.notes: horror-a-brass:0 has the brass collar and the yellow eyes; the subject asks for four tentacles, and it stands on legs with toes.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the darkest blues of the cloth: every dark navy shadow on the hood and on the robe becomes the medium indigo blue #372f8f, the same hue as the lit cloth and only a little darker than it. The lit indigo parts do not change. Keep the black inside of the hood, the two cream eyes, the candle with its green flame, the paper scroll, the badge, the slippers, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: A second way to the same end: lift only the navy shades of initiate-a-indigo:0, naming no lighter lit tone.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only three colours. The starry robe becomes a violet-leaning indigo blue, colour #4a43b5 on the lit left side and #372f8f in the folds, not grey and not navy. The white of the one big eye becomes pale yellow, colour #ffe27a, with the black pupil kept. The collar becomes polished yellow brass, colour #c9a24a. Keep the cream stars, the teal tentacles, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: herald-e-tall:0 is 53 x 97 px with no hands, feet or tool; its robe is slate navy, its eye cream and its collar red-brown.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only two colours. The inside of the open mouth and the gums become dark teal, colour #145f6b, with no purple, no violet and no pink. The darkest red-brown shadows of the brass collar and its chain become dark brass, colour #8a6a2a, with no red. Keep the cream teeth, the round teal body, the two big pale yellow eyes, the bright brass collar, the cream belly, the four tentacle feet, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: horror-a-tentacles:0 is the Horror of the direction; about 80 px of purple and pink in its mouth and 50 px of red-brown collar shadow are left, and gate 4 allows no violet and no red pixel.

recipes.editInstruction: Make the creature a little taller without making it wider: lengthen the bell-shaped starry robe downward so that its round hem touches the very bottom edge of the image, and lengthen the tentacles of the crown upward so that their tips touch the very top edge of the image. Keep the one big pale yellow eye, the brass collar, the stars, the blue robe, the hanging sleeves, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: herald-e-tall-indigo:0 has the yellow eye, the brass collar and a blue robe, and is 53 x 97 px: three more pixels for gate 3.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only two small things. The pointed tip of the hood becomes longer and flops over to the right side, hanging down like the tip of a nightcap. The two bare hands become pale cream mittens, colour #f3e7c4, so no skin shows. Keep the blue hood and robe, the black inside of the hood, the two cream eyes, the candle with its green flame, the paper scroll, the badge, the slippers, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: initiate-a-indigo:0 is the indigo Initiate; the direction asks for a tip that flops (its outline tell) and for no skin.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one colour: the purple and pink gums inside the grin become dark teal, colour #145f6b. The mouth stays exactly the same wide happy grin with every cream tooth in its place. Keep the round teal body, the two big pale yellow eyes, the brass collar, the cream belly, the four tentacle feet, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: horror-a-mouth turned the grin into a black hole with loose teeth: a narrower edit of the gums only.
